fixes.explanation: Second is one short, friend. The text says, "This was now the third time that Jesus appeared to the disciples after He was raised from the dead." (John 21:14) So this breakfast by the sea is number THREE. I spent years in a junk drawer with nothing to do but count dust, and even I can count to three!

problems.problem: The explanation still feels generic. Capitalizing THREE and calling the baker friend do not give it Papa Dorin's distinctive personality, and the closing observation lands flat.
